semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Chiba University, Aoki Laboratory is involved in semiconductor research, particularly in the development of advanced transistor technologies.
summary: Chiba University, Aoki Laboratory focuses on research related to field-effect transistors (TFETs) using transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs). Their work includes doping techniques utilizing laser irradiation to fabricate CMOS structures, which may have implications for future semiconductor applications.
